description: This is a Java class named 'FlagUtils' that provides utility functions to query and manipulate intent and activity manifest flags in an Android application. It includes methods for discovering active flags on intents, listing all possible flags, categorizing flags, and examining activity manifest flags.

classes.name: FlagUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for extracting and analyzing intent and activity flags in an Android environment.

methods.name: discoverFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of string names of flags that are active on the provided Intent object.

methods.name: getIntentFlagsAsString
methods.description: Returns a list of all available intent flag names as strings.

methods.name: getAllIntentFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of all defined IntentFlag enum constants.

methods.name: intentFlagsByCategory
methods.description: Categorizes intent flags into different groups based on suffixes and returns them as a map.

methods.name: hasSuffix
methods.description: Checks if a given string ends with any of the specified suffixes.

methods.name: flagValue
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value of a specific intent flag by its field name.

methods.name: hasIntentFlag
methods.description: Determines if an Intent has a specific flag set, given the flag's name.

methods.name: hasIntentFlag
methods.description: Determines if an Intent has a specific flag set, given the IntentFlag enum.

methods.name: hasActivityFlag
methods.description: Checks if a specified activity component has a particular activity manifest flag.

methods.name: getActivityFlags
methods.description: Returns a set of ActivityFlag enums indicating flags set on the specified activity component by examining its manifest info.

methods.name: getActivityFlags
methods.description: Overloaded method: retrieves activity flags based on ActivityInfo object.

methods.name: loadActivityInfo
methods.description: Loads activity information from the package manager if not already loaded.

methods.name: getFlagForString
methods.description: Maps a string flag name to its corresponding IntentFlag enum.

methods.name: camelify
methods.description: Converts a snake_case string to camelCase.
